title: How NS is shaping the next generation of Women in Technology
body_markdown:
**NS and WIT give students a look inside tech careers**


**Top Takeaway:** Through our partnership with Women in Technology, Norfolk Southern is helping inspire the next generation of technology leaders by giving students hands-on experience solving real business challenges and exploring STEM careers that power the railroad.


Norfolk Southern recently partnered with Women in Technology (WIT) to welcome students from across Georgia for a Career Exploration Day focused on technology, innovation, and problem-solving.


The event gave students a firsthand look at how technology powers the railroad, while challenging them to tackle real-world business scenarios alongside Norfolk Southern employees. Through hands-on activities and dynamic conversations with STEM professionals, students actively explored career possibilities, asked questions and connected their interests to opportunities in technology.


"Our partnership with Women in Technology gives students the opportunity to connect classroom learning with real-world experiences and see the many ways technology supports the railroad," said Courtney Massey, Manager, Service Partner Performance Management. "By opening our doors, sharing our expertise and creating opportunities to role play in solving meaningful business challenges, we're helping young women build confidence as they see themselves shaping the future of technology."


Together, Norfolk Southern and WIT are helping inspire the next generation of women leaders and innovators by showing them what's possible when curiosity, technology, and opportunity come together.
